title: Mixed Event — Our Precious Memories — Episode7 A Youth Well Spent

meta.Event Outline: As the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy school year draws to a close, Saki revisits her "100 Things I Want To Do" list. She makes up her mind to cross off the whole list, especially No. 95: "Make lots of fun memories and put them in a photo album!"

rows.Line: The next day
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see, the section for photo albums is... Oh, here it is!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This one's the kind where you glue in your photos... Oh, this one's the kind with pockets! They come in so many colors and shapes too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmmm, which do I pick...?
This animal one is cute, and this one with the starry pattern...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, huh? Over there, that's...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haaaruuukaaa!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Saki? What a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It is! Are you shopping too, Haruka?
Wait, that thing you're holding...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, I've been found out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, I'm here looking at photo albums too. Seeing what you've been doing made me want to put one together myself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're making one too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I've mentioned this before, but I was busy with work up through junior high, so it'd been a while since I enjoyed my school life like I have been lately...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I thought to myself that I'd like to make my memories of this year last, like you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, let's show each other when they're finished!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That sounds nice. I'd like to see your photo album too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh yeah, did you get that picture of us playing dodgeball from Ichika and the others? The one with you and me in it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah I did!
From when we hit Emu, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The one where we're high-fiving and shouting, “Yay!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, that one. I got that from Ichika as well. I wanted to put it in my album.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I had no idea! Then, we'll be matching♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, but there might be other matching pictures!
Look, I have this picture from the Sports Festival, and some from when we went on the field trip too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh... You're right.
You've got pictures from the School Festival, and the ones we took with Minori and the others the other day too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It just goes to show how many fun times I've had with you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! You're right!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for giving me these wonderful memories, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm really happy I got to be in the same class as you...and got to become your friend.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: C'mon... The same goes for me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Eating lunch with you, taking classes together, doing our best during all those school events, hanging out and having fun together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All of that was suuuper fun, so...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... I'll treasure the memories I made with you, forever and always!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah... I will too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just one more reason to work hard on our photo albums!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright!
I've got all the materials, so it's time to do my best making this album!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
First, I've gotta choose which pictures to use!
If I add up all the ones on my phone, plus the ones I got from Shiho and the girls... Whoa, it looks like there's around five hundred!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: With this many, it'll probably be pretty tough to pick out which I want to use... But I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see, first I'll separate them by season... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I remember this one!
This is from when I went to PXL with Ichi and the girls! Tsukasa and his troupe showed us around...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh yeah! The haunted house was scarier than we expected, and Hona and I screamed a whole lot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... This is from the first time we performed at a live house!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There weren't many people in the audience, and I was super nervous, but we got to perform our own song, and I had a lot of fun...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've got all these pictures of our school events too...! The Seaside School, the School Festival...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'd seen school festivals on dramas and stuff and always wanted to go to one, so I was really happy about it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Both the event itself and the time we spent preparing for it all just screamed “youth”!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've really been making the most of my youth...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Back then, I always felt like I was gonna be left behind all on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Everyone else would be doing all kinds of fun stuff like playing with their friends or going on the school trip... But I could never be part of that...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It felt like I was fading out of everyone's lives... And I was scared.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But now...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh... You're right.
You've got pictures from the School Festival, and the ones we took with Minori and the others the other day too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It just goes to show how many fun times I've had with you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I've been able to make lots of memories with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm also a part of everyone's memories...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I've made so many memories that I'm having trouble choosing between all these pictures... I'm so glad.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This is all thanks to everyone around me...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They offered to make more memories with me, and helped me with the list of things I wanted to do... That made me really happy.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I want to thank them all properly...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But... How can I do that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I just came up with something good♪
